hints.title: Transitive Interval Overlap
hints.text: Overlapping intervals must be in the same group, which means any chain of connected intervals forms a single independent component.

hints.title: Merging Sorted Intervals
hints.text: Sort ranges by their start times and merge overlapping intervals to determine the number of disjoint components k.

hints.title: Binary Group Combinatorics
hints.text: Each independent component can be assigned to group 1 or group 2 independently, resulting in 2^k possibilities modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Connected Component Counting Implementation

variables: n: number of intervals in ranges
complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); component count takes O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Building an explicit graph of overlaps takes O(n^2) space and time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Merges intervals and calculates power of two for disjoint groups.
